hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only the afterInitialize flag is active; the callback is a no-op returning only the selector. The contract also exposes an `initializePools()` function (separate from the hook callback) that delegates to an external liquidity bootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and record an initial tick.
